sources.title: Maine DACF Public Boat Launch inventory — Penobscot River, Hampden (site 19280)
sources.accessEvidence: The official inventory lists the Penobscot River site in Hampden as a local hard ramp, 50 feet by 200 feet, all-tide, and publishes 44.76540, -68.79690.
sources.coordinateInterpretation: Official public launch-site coordinate. The table does not say whether this is the ramp head or the wet toe; keep it as an access-area anchor.

sources.title: Maine DMR Angler's Guide — Hampden / Frankfort
sources.accessEvidence: Identifies a public boat ramp at Turtle Head Marina off Route 1A in Hampden; describes the ramp as in good condition and serviced by a float.
sources.interpretation: Independent confirmation of public boat-ramp access in Hampden; used as corroboration of public access, not as a coordinate for DACF site 19280.

sources.title: Hampden 2024 Comprehensive Plan
sources.accessEvidence: Lists the marina and boat launch at Turtle Head Marina as an existing local recreation asset.
sources.interpretation: Official local-planning corroboration; not a coordinate source.

sources.title: Google Maps satellite imagery inspected 2026-09-18
sources.interpretation: The coordinate falls within the waterfront marina/launch-site area, but imagery did not establish the exact ramp toe with sufficient confidence for a coordinate move.

sources.title: USGS National Hydrography Dataset flowline, area, and waterbody services
sources.interpretation: Distances flag a precision gap but do not disprove an official long-ramp access-site coordinate.
